# lean-toolchain Template

Use this exact template for `lean-toolchain`.

```text
LEAN-TOOLCHAIN
```

## Notes

- Keep the file to a single line with a trailing newline.
- Use an exact toolchain, for example `leanprover/lean4:v4.25.0`.
- Do not infer the Mathlib or PFR dependency ref from this file unless the skill workflow says the derivation is clean and verified.
